tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search over the public pages: pattern names, aliases and summaries, research records, starter formations and API guides. Returns at most 10 results with a path to pass to `fetch`. Matches text only; it never ranks patterns.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the Markdown document of any public page, exactly as HTTP serves it, from a root-relative path (/patterns/supervisor.md) or a https://topologyindex.com URL. Private tenant routes are not reachable here.

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: The pattern catalogue and decision guide (/patterns/index.md). With a family, only that family’s section of the same page.

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: One pattern page (/patterns/{pattern}.md): definition, aliases, when it is hypothesised to fit, failure modes, sources and whether this deployment can execute it. Accepts a pattern identifier or a known alias.

tools.name: list_starters
tools.description: The starter formation index (/starters/index.md): unvalidated, unsigned FORMATION.md documents to copy and register privately.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
